name: Cradle of Embers — T-Shaped World & Continent Top-Down Atlas (L2J.RU / L2Hub / PMFun Standard)
design_philosophy: Adopt the proven Lineage II (L2J.RU Gracia Final, L2Hub.info, and PMFun) Top-Down World & Zone Database Architecture using a T-Shaped Production Strategy: (1) T-BREADTH HORIZONTAL BAR — index the entire 3-continent world on a unified [X_grid]_[Y_grid] coordinate tile grid (`all_interlaced.jpg` style) and a 6-category Zone Directory (Starting Towns, Castle/Hub Towns, Fields & Hunting Areas, Regular Dungeons, Seven-Signs/God-Seal Catacombs & Necropolises, and Harbors/Clan Halls/Fortresses) with level headers (`Zone Name: lvl.X [min-max]`) and `loc=X:Y` coordinates; (2) T-DEPTH VERTICAL BAR — dig deep to 100% database-grade completion on ONE linked starter cluster (1 Starting Town + 1 Field Hunting Area + 1 Multi-Room Dungeon + Full Mob Drop/Spoil Sheets) to validate the end-to-end gameplay and tooling loop before expanding other zones.

reference_benchmarks.source_name: L2J.RU Gracia Final Database (Maps, Zones, Dungeons & Mobs)
extracted_patterns: Interlaced World Grid (`all_interlaced.jpg`): Master world map divided into `[15_10]..[26_25]` server coordinate tiles overlaying Aden, Elmore, and Gracia.

4-Column Maps Directory (`p=10`): Categorizes world locations into Towns (6 Racial Starting Villages + 12 Castle/Hub Towns), Dungeons (8 Regular Dungeons + 14 Seven Signs Catacombs/Necropolises), Clan Halls (8), and Fortresses (21).

Dual-Map Zone Page (`p=24&t=1&id=243`): Header `Zone Name: lvl.X [min-max]`, top Parchment Illustrated Map with red spawn pins + bottom Top-Down Satellite Radar Map with red spawn clusters, followed by the 8-column NPC/Monster Spawn Table (`Name`, `Type`, `Level`, `Agr.`, `Race`, `X`, `Protections`, `Weaknesses`).

Side-by-Side Dungeon Map (`Elven Ruins: lvl.9 [9-22]`): Left map shows the overland entrance X pin relative to the racial starter town; Right map shows the top-down underground room-and-corridor layout with red spawn clusters.

Mob Detail Sheet (`p=1&id=20535` Prairie Keltir): 3D portrait + Stats (`HP/MP/Exp/SP`, `HP/MP Reg`) + Combat (`P.Atk/P.Def/M.Atk/M.Def/Atk.Spd/Cast.Spd/Walk/Run`) + Basic (`STR/INT/DEX/WIT/CON/MEN`) + Social (`Aggro/Social/Undead/Range`) + `Inhabits in` links + Grouped `Drop` table (`Group 0 Adena`, `Group 1 Equipment`, `Group 2 Crafting Materials/Recipes`) + `Spoil` table.
Direct URL Coordinate Deep-Linking (`?loc=X:Y`): Every NPC, monster spawn cluster, raid boss, and teleport point has a deterministic world coordinate (`X:Y`) that centers and pins the top-down map.
Layer Toggles between Illustrated World Parchment and High-Contrast Terrain Radar.

Multi-Scale Cartography: World Relief Maps (`Aden World Map`, `Elmore World Map`, `Gracia Star Stones Map`), Detailed Town Blueprints (`Dion Castle Town (detailed).png` with Guild/Shop/Gatekeeper callouts), and Multi-Floor Dungeon Maps.

t_deep_validation_slice.slice_rationale: T-Depth Vertical Validation Cluster in District D01 (`district-teacup-meadows`, Grid Sector `18_24` on Continent 01). Rather than prematurely expanding all 167 studio nodes, we dig deep to 100% L2J.RU / L2Hub / PMFun database fidelity on ONE connected trio: (1) ONE Starting Town (`town-lantern-hollow` · Lantern Hollow Village), (2) ONE Field Hunting Zone (`hunting-area-clover-south-gate` · Clover South-Gate Meadow), (3) ONE Multi-Room Dungeon (`dungeon-kiln-cellar` · Kiln Cellar Ruins), and (4) Full Mob Drop/Spoil Database Sheets (`Prairie Keltir`, `Feral Kiln-Hound`, `Discarded Kiln-Guardian Raid Boss`).
